advisory.finding: The SNAPSHOT-folding branch of the fix (both the modern `attestations`-dict fold and the legacy single-`signature` fold) has no test. Both new tests use un-compacted tickets whose kinds derive only from live SIGNATURE files; after compaction, SIGNATURE events are retired and projected kinds must come from the SNAPSHOT's compiled_state — the very path in `_ondisk_attestation_kinds` (lines 88-103) that would then govern whether a compacted signed ticket's cache is a HIT or MISS. A regression that mis-derives kinds from a SNAPSHOT (wrong key, legacy fold broken) would let read_cache spuriously MISS on every compacted signed ticket, or fail to reject a stale post-compaction cache, and neither test would catch it.
